newsitem.title: FRANCE: French car exports up 9.4 percent in 1996 - CCFA.
newsitem.headline: French car exports up 9.4 percent in 1996 - CCFA.

text.p: French car exports rose 9.4 percent in 1996 to 2,026,800 units from 1,852,053 in 1995, the French carmakers association CCFA said on Wednesday.
French car production rose 3.2 percent in 1996 to 3,147,622 units from 3,050,929 in the previous year.
Exports by the PSA Peugeot Citroen group rose 8.9 percent to 1,135,404 units in 1996, while Renault SA exported 866,721 cars, up 9.7 percent.
The PSA group's car production rose 4.4 percent to 1,729,654 last year. Renault car production was 1.4 percent higher at 1,393,889.
